name: publishing-health
description: Health bot — system checks, disk space, security audit

steps.name: check-ollama
steps.command: curl -s --max-time 3 http://localhost:11434/api/tags 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'{len(d.get(\"models\",[]))} models loaded')" 2>/dev/null || echo 'ollama not responding'

steps.name: check-recent-files
steps.command: echo '=== Recent recipes ===' && ls -t ~/gullahgeecheebiz-site/recipes/*.html 2>/dev/null | head -5 && echo '=== Recent pins ===' && ls -t ~/pins-daily/ 2>/dev/null | head -3 && echo '=== Recent ebooks ===' && ls -t ~/ebooks/for-upload/ 2>/dev/null | head -3
